turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how's everything with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm alright, a bit tired.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm choosing between two flats for next term. One's right on the tram line but pricier.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: And the cheaper one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Bus plus a transfer, about forty minutes.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: So extra rent versus time every day. Which matters more right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just a sec, I need to sort something out with my roommate. I'll say when I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, no rush.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Was that the doorbell or the TV?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The TV, I think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Does this smell like it's burning to you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A little, yeah. How long has it been in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Only twenty minutes. The recipe says forty.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Our oven runs hot though. Remember the pizza?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, right. Should I cover it with foil?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, and turn it down a bit. The middle probably still needs time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, which wins, the tram flat or the cheaper one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The tram one. I'd rather sleep in.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Honestly, that extra time adds up. Over a year, it's days of your life back.
